newsitem.title: UKRAINE: Ukraine may lower refinancing rate in July - c.bank.
newsitem.headline: Ukraine may lower refinancing rate in July - c.bank.

text.p: The head of Ukraine's central bank said on Friday the bank would consider next month whether to lower the refinancing rate of 21 percent which has been in effect since May.
"We will consider this on the second or third of July," Viktor Yushchenko said at a news conference.
He also said it was possible the rate, which is the level at which banks borrow from the central bank, could be lowered in the near future.
The bank has been trying to keep the refinancing rate in tandem with slowing inflation, which Yushchenko forecast would be about 0.2 percent in June against 0.8 percent in May.
Ukrainian officials have forecast annual inflation at about 17 percent this year compared to 39.7 percent in 1996.
